basis: Transmissible prion disease causes progressive CNS degeneration; infectious classification applies despite absent immune response.
Benign epithelial neoplasm arising in ethmoid sinus respiratory mucosa.
Heme synthesis disorder with defining neurovisceral attacks; hepatic synthesis alone does not establish liver injury. Skin damage and biallelic hemolysis are minority manifestations.
Inherited retinal cone dysfunction causes absent color vision and reduced visual acuity.
Benign melanocytic skin neoplasm; extracutaneous subtypes do not define the umbrella.
Defining lipodystrophy, thin skin and hypotrichosis; slender bones in 7/7 and amyotrophy in 3/3 support muscle/bone involvement; entropion occurs in 80–99%.
Peroxisomal lipid metabolism disorder defined by retinal dystrophy, cerebral white matter disease and developmental impairment.
Carcinoma originates in oral cavity mucosa, which belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Polydactyly establishes a skeletal developmental disorder; the supplied record lacks evidence for additional organ involvement.
Inherited structural disease of the mitral valve.
Deficiency of circulating eosinophils is a blood-cell disorder; immunodeficiency is not established.
Defined by severe insulin and lipid metabolic abnormalities together with skeletal myopathy.
Developmental hip joint disease with acetabular hypoplasia and congenital dislocation.
Astrocytic tumor arising in the brain or spinal cord.
MELAS defines mitochondrial metabolic disease with encephalopathy and myopathy; hearing loss affects roughly half of MELAS patients, although MTTS1-specific frequency is uncertain.
Typically immune-mediated inflammatory optic neuropathy; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis. Associated CNS diseases are separate diagnoses.
XP/CS combines photosensitive skin disease and neurodegeneration; ocular degeneration and hearing loss are common (>30%) in the combined phenotype; XPF-specific data are limited.
Umbrella of progressive cerebellar neurodegenerative disorders; additional organs vary across subtypes.
Arthropathy directly affects joints; associated progeria does not establish systemic involvement for this joint-specific concept.
Nonsyndromic inherited sensorineural hearing loss; hearing impairment reported in 12/12 patients.
Ectopic implantation in the ovary is an obstetric/reproductive disorder; no endocrine dysfunction is established.
Disordered glucose metabolism; later diabetes and vascular complications are risks rather than direct organ involvement.
Structural narrowing of the lumbar vertebral canal; pain and claudication alone do not establish lasting neurologic damage.
Lens displacement, cataracts, chorioretinal dystrophy and retinal detachment are confined to the ocular axis.
Genus-level bacterial infection umbrella; respiratory, meningeal and genital sites vary, so no single anatomical axis applies across the group.
